proposed_widenings.name: companion_summon
proposed_widenings.justification: Find Familiar creates a persistent autonomous companion entity (the familiar). No existing SpellMechanics family can express this: activation phases are limited to attack_roll/save_gate; ongoing_effect requires concentration/timed duration and only supports roll_modifier or damage_on_hit operations; anchored_trigger creates a planted trigger, not a persistent actor. The spell needs a new family that expresses: (1) creation of a companion entity, (2) the companion's ongoing capabilities (telepathic link, sense sharing, touch delivery), and (3) companion lifecycle management (disappear at 0 HP, dismiss to pocket dimension, recall, permanent dismiss).
proposed_widenings.evidence: You gain the service of a familiar, a spirit that takes an animal form you choose... Your familiar acts independently of you, but it obeys your commands... It rolls its own Initiative and acts on its own turn.

proposed_widenings.name: CompanionCapabilityEffect
proposed_widenings.justification: The familiar's ongoing capabilities (telepathic link within 100 ft, Bonus Action senses sharing until next turn start, Reaction-based touch delivery) need a structured capability list on the companion. The v4 atoms telepathic_link and deliver_touch_spell exist but there is no surface type that can enumerate multiple passive/active companion capabilities as a structured list on the companion record.
proposed_widenings.evidence: While your familiar is within 100 feet of you, you can communicate with it telepathically. Additionally, as a Bonus Action, you can see through the familiar's eyes and hear what it hears until the start of your next turn... when you cast a spell with a range of touch, your familiar can deliver the touch... it must take a Reaction to deliver the touch.

proposed_widenings.name: CompanionLifecycle (recall / pocket-dimension dismiss)
proposed_widenings.justification: The familiar can be temporarily dismissed to a pocket dimension (Magic action) and recalled from it (Magic action while dismissed). transport_exile covers exile; but the bidirectional Magic-action recall pattern — distinct from 'return_on_end' — has no surface variant. The permanent-dismiss path (release the bond forever) also lacks a surface type.
proposed_widenings.evidence: As a Magic action, you can temporarily dismiss the familiar to a pocket dimension. Alternatively, you can dismiss it forever. As a Magic action while it is temporarily dismissed, you can cause it to reappear in an unoccupied space within 30 feet of you.

notes: All required v4 atoms exist (create_companion, companion, telepathic_link, deliver_touch_spell, transport_exile). The gap is entirely at the SpellMechanics family level: no existing family shape (ongoing_effect, activation, triggered_reaction, anchored_trigger) can honestly hold companion-summoning semantics. A new 'companion_summon' family is needed. The spell is also the canonical pressure case for the SMN (summoning) misc tag pattern — many other summon spells (Conjure Animals, Animate Dead, etc.) will require the same family.
